entities.title: The build publishes public/.dev
entities.summary: build.mjs copies public/ into dist/ whole, so public/.dev and its knowledge files become static assets of the deployed game.
entities.expected: dist/ holds only what the game serves: the page, its styles, game.js and _headers.
entities.observed: npm run build puts public/.dev/*.json at dist/games/retro/shatterbelt/.dev/, which wrangler deploy uploads with the other assets unless something leaves it out (not checked against Cloudflare).
acceptanceCriteria: After npm run build, dist/ has no .dev folder, or the assets upload leaves it out (an .assetsignore, say).

origin.description: Found when public/.dev was added and the build run while documenting Shatterbelt.

entities.title: The README's local run stops at the sign-in
entities.summary: Following Deploy › Local leads to a redirect to /auth/sign-in that nothing on localhost answers.
entities.expected: The README's local steps reach a playable game.
entities.observed: Read from the code, not run: gamePage redirects a signed-out visit to /auth/sign-in; this Worker never calls the library's handle(), so that path falls through to the static assets and is not found. The library's stand-in sign-in needs DEV_SIGN_IN set to "true" and a session cookie of its own making, and the README mentions neither.
acceptanceCriteria: The README (or a runbook) says how to sign in locally, and its steps reach the title screen.

origin.description: Found while writing the run-locally runbook from the README and the Worker's code.
